start_text:
🎉 *Welcome to Trendyol Price Tracker!*

💰 I track Trendyol prices and notify you about discounts.

🚀 *How to start:*
• Send a product link
• Choose notification mode
• Get price change alerts!

📱 Use buttons below or send /help
send_link_prompt: Send a Trendyol product link (full URL).
not_trendyol: This doesn't look like a Trendyol link. Please send a URL like https://www.trendyol.com/...
invalid_url: ❌ Invalid URL. Please send a valid Trendyol product link.
no_subs: You are not tracking any products yet. Send a Trendyol product link.
error_generic: 😔 Something went wrong. Please try again in a couple of minutes.
error_timeout: ⏰ Trendyol server is responding too slowly. Try again in 5-10 minutes.
error_network: 🌐 Internet connection interrupted. Check your connection and try again.
error_database: 💾 Temporary data storage issue. Try again in a minute.
error_invalid_id: ❌ This subscription number doesn't exist. Check /mysubs for your subscriptions list.
error_url_too_long: ❌ URL is too long. Try shortening the URL or send a different link.
error_not_your_sub: 🤔 This subscription belongs to another user.
unsubscribed_all: All your subscriptions have been removed.
no_subs_found_id: No product found for that number.
provide_mode_options: Please choose a notification mode: hourly or discount.
error_runcheck: ⚙️ Technical check completed with error. Administrator has been notified.
subscribed_no_price: ✅ Product added. Couldn't fetch current price now — I'll try later.
help_text:
🚀 Trendyol Price Tracker

Hi! I track Trendyol prices and notify you about discounts.

📱 How to use:
• Send a product link
• Choose notification mode
• Get price change alerts!

🎛️ Basic commands:
/mysubs - my subscriptions
/history - price chart
/settings - settings

💡 Full help: /help full

❓ Need help? Send /report
help_full:
📚 FULL HELP

🔗 SUBSCRIPTIONS:
• Send Trendyol product link
• /mysubs - view products
• /unsubscribe NUMBER - remove product

📊 PRICE ANALYSIS:
• /history NUMBER - price chart
• /price_alert NUMBER PRICE - notify at price
• /setmode NUMBER hourly/discount - notification mode

⚙️ SETTINGS:
• /settings quiet HOUR1 HOUR2 - quiet hours
• /settings price NUMBER min/max/percent - ranges
• /language - change language

💬 OTHER:
• /ping - check connection
• /report - contact admin
• /about - about bot
onboarding_welcome:
👋 *Hi! Let's get to know the bot*

I'll help you track Trendyol prices and save on purchases!

Want to see how it works?
onboarding_explain:

onboarding_complete:
🎉 Great! Now you know how to use the bot.

Use the buttons below or send /help for more information.
onboarding_skipped:
Okay, you can start anytime!

Use the buttons below or send /help for help.
already_subscribed: You are already tracking this product.
not_product_url: This doesn't look like a Trendyol product page URL.
provide_subscription_id: Provide a product number from your list.
about_text: The bot tracks Trendyol prices and notifies you on changes.
settings_usage:
Command for notification settings:
/settings quiet <start> <end> — configure quiet hours (0-23)
/settings price <product number> min:<price> max:<price> percent:<percent> — configure price alerts
/settings interval <product number> <minutes> — notification interval (min 15 minutes)
quiet_hours_usage:
Usage: /settings quiet <start> <end>
Example: /settings quiet 23 7 — quiet hours from 23:00 to 7:00
price_alerts_usage:
Usage: /settings price <product number> min:<price> max:<price> percent:<percent>
Example: /settings price 1 min:100 max:500 percent:10
interval_usage:
Usage: /settings interval <product number> <minutes>
Example: /settings interval 1 60 — notifications every hour
notification_open_hint: Open the product or check the price history with the buttons below.
status_checking_product: 🔎 Checking the product and price. This usually takes a few seconds...
status_loading_history: 📈 Collecting the price history. This may take a little while if there is a lot of data...
status_loading_trends: 🔎 Looking for current products. This may take a few seconds...
trending_unavailable: We currently do not have full access to trending data. We'll notify you when access becomes available.
rate_limit_exceeded: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
compare_no_similar: No similar products found for comparison
admin_commands:
📋 *Admin commands:*

`/admin stats` - user and subscription statistics
`/admin broadcast <message>` - broadcast to all users
`/admin users` - list of active users
`/admin recommend` - manage recommended products
`/admin cleanup` - cleanup old/inactive data
`/admin backup` - manual database backup
admin_unknown_command: ❌ Unknown command. Use /admin for command list
admin_users_hint: 💡 Use: /admin users <ID> for detailed user information
alerts_too_many: ⚠️ You have too many subscriptions. Use /mysubs command to manage each subscription individually.
alerts_edit_help: Send a message with new alert price in format: price (example: 2500) Or press button to remove alert.
import_instruction: Send a file in JSON or CSV format with your subscriptions.
compare_error_no_price: ❌ Failed to get prices for product comparison.
recommend_no_data: ❌ Not enough data for recommendations. Add more subscriptions!
recommend_hint: Click the button to view the product on Trendyol
stats_no_history: 📊 Price history not collected yet. Try later.
price_alert_usage:
Usage: /price_alert <product number> <target price>
Example: /price_alert 1 2500
You will be notified when the price drops below this value
price_alert_id_must_be_number: Product number must be a number
price_alert_price_must_be_number: Target price must be a number
price_alert_set_success:
✅ Target price set: {price:.0f} TL
ℹ️ You will be notified when the price drops below this value
price_alert_set_success_already_below:
✅ Target price set: {target:.0f} TL
ℹ️ Current price: {current:.0f} TL
ℹ️ Price is already below target!
history_export_no_data: 📊 No history data for this subscription.
history_plot_no_data: 📊 No history data for this subscription.
mysubs_limit_notice: Shown {shown} of {total}. To avoid spamming the chat, open the rest later.
subscription_added_hint_discount: By default, I'll message you only when the price drops. You can change the mode below.
subscription_added_hint_hourly: I'll check this product every hour. You can change the mode below.
subscription_added_hint_waiting_price: I couldn't get the price right now. I'll try updating it during the next check.
report_prompt: 📝 Describe your problem or suggestion: Send a message with detailed description
report_too_short: ❌ Message is too short. Please describe the problem in more detail (at least 5 characters).
report_sent: ✅ Your message has been sent to administrator! We will review your complaint/suggestion and contact you soon.
admin_unknown_command: ❌ Unknown admin command. Available: stats, broadcast, users, cleanup, backup, respond
admin_users_interactive_hint: Click on user button to view detailed information
admin_only: ❌ This function is for administrators only
❌ This feature is for administrators only
